key_insight: The paper learns Koopman embeddings with a kernel-based autoencoder trained via bilevel optimization, avoiding a fixed hand-designed dictionary.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable, more interpretable alternative to neural autoencoders for nonlinear system identification, forecasting, and reduced-order modeling.
method: Use EDMD with a learned kernel dictionary instead of a preset feature map.
Optimize the dictionary and Koopman approximation jointly with bilevel optimization.
Keep kernel matrix size tied to collocation points, improving scalability.
evidence_signal: In experiments on sea-surface-temperature forecasting and video data, EDMD-kDL matched or outperformed ANN-based approaches.
watch_item: Performance depends on choosing effective collocation points and kernel settings, which can affect stability and generalization.
paper_title: Bilevel optimization for data-driven learning of Koopman embeddings using kernel-based autoencoders
